description: The chart illustrates five different bar chart patterns, labeled as Increasing, Uniform, Decreasing, Spindle, and Bottleneck, with the category labels on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis is unlabeled but appears to represent a value or magnitude, with a linear scale and no visible tick labels or units. Each pattern consists of a set of four bars, colored in a light green shade, with varying heights. The Increasing pattern shows bars with heights that increase from left to right, with the shortest bar at approximately one-quarter of the height of the tallest bar. The Uniform pattern displays bars of roughly equal height. The Decreasing pattern features bars with heights that decrease from left to right, with the tallest bar being approximately three times the height of the shortest bar. The Spindle pattern has bars with heights that increase and then decrease, with the middle two bars being significantly taller than the outer bars. The Bottleneck pattern shows bars with heights that decrease and then increase, with the middle two bars being shorter than the outer bars. The bars within each pattern are not sorted in a specific order other than their inherent pattern, and none of the bars are visually emphasized.
